import json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')

newsha='b2869e334d9d68a0c988905e71ce0badec6ba359'
old=root/'releases'/oldsha
new=root/'releases'/newsha
cur=root/'current'
nextp=root/'current.next-hopper-private'
services=('ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads')
def active():
 return {name:subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',name],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip() for name in services}
out={'action':'activate_ferrari_merged_release','from':oldsha,'to':newsha,'switched':False,'rollback':False}
try:
 assert cur.is_symlink() and cur.resolve()==old,'unexpected current Ferrari SHA'
 assert new.is_dir() and not new.is_symlink() and (new/'engine/rea_mcp.py').is_file()
 assert (root/'tools/hopper-6.6.1/opt/hopper/bin/Hopper').is_file()
 assert not nextp.exists() and not nextp.is_symlink()
 pre=active();assert all(v=='active' for v in pre.values()),'critical services not all active before change'
 test=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-c',"from pathlib import Path;from engine.rea_mcp import _resources; c,e=_resources(Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal'));print(e.get('HOPPER_LAUNCHER_PATH','missing'))"],cwd=new,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
 assert test.returncode==0 and test.stdout.strip()==str(root/'tools/hopper-6.6.1/opt/hopper/bin/Hopper')
 os.symlink(str(new),str(nextp))
 os.replace(nextp,cur)
 out['switched']=True
 assert cur.resolve()==new
 smoke=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-m','engine.ferrari','doctor'],cwd=cur,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=55)
 out['ferrari_doctor_exit']=smoke.returncode
 assert smoke.returncode==0,'Ferrari doctor failure'
 after=active()
 out['services_after']=after
 assert all(v=='active' for v in after.values()),'critical services changed'
 out['status']='ACTIVATED_VERIFIED'
except Exception as e:
 out.update({'status':'FAILED','reason':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:190]})
 if out['switched']:
  try:
   if nextp.exists() or nextp.is_symlink():nextp.unlink()
   os.symlink(str(old),str(nextp))
   os.replace(nextp,cur)
   out['rollback']=True
  except Exception as rb:out['rollback_error']=str(rb)[:150]
finally:
 if nextp.is_symlink():nextp.unlink()
out['current_final']=str(cur.resolve(strict=False))
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
